statement: This sketch presents a collection of polygonal shapes that drift gently across the screen in a subtle, randomized motion. When pieces come into proximity with one another, they snap into perfect alignment, revealing a hidden colorful pattern beneath them. Users can interact by clicking and dragging individual pieces to reposition or rotate them, temporarily pausing their autonomous movement. The visual effect combines organic wandering with precise geometric snapping, creating an engaging interplay between chaos and order as the shapes form new configurations through user manipulation.
